description: This file defines the EmployeeDirectoryModel class used in the OrangeHRM system, specifically within the Corporate Directory API. It models employee data attributes for serialization, including properties like employee number, name, job title, department, and location, and implements a normalization interface.

classes.name: EmployeeDirectoryModel
classes.description: A model class representing an employee's directory information, used for API serialization and response formatting.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with an Employee entity and sets up filters and attribute mappings.
